DTC Returns Abuse Playbook: Fair Tiered Policy with Graduated Responses
Galaxy Forge Implementation Kit v1.0 (September 2026)

FILES

- dtc_returns_abuse_playbook_workbook.xlsx : Excel workbook (5 sheets)

HOW TO USE: start with Quick Start (section 2 of the guide), then work the 14-day plan in section 9.
SUPPORT: email support for file/usage questions within 7 days of purchase.
